**The per-machine adapter, and the answer carried back**

work-unit · 2026-08-21

Discharges: [MUS-M-0006](../milestones.md#mus-m-0006)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0062](../decisions.md#mus-d-0062), [MUS-D-0063](../decisions.md#mus-d-0063), [MUS-D-0064](../decisions.md#mus-d-0064), [MUS-D-0065](../decisions.md#mus-d-0065)

## Context

Sessions Mustur starts, supervises and can type into, and the delivery of an answered decision into the session that raised it.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0006 (4a): the adapter starts and supervises a long-lived session per project inside tmux, and an answered decision is delivered back into the session that raised it.

## Done means

mustur session start runs a configured CLI in a named tmux session, one per project, refusing a second.
mustur session list shows only sessions Mustur started; anything else on the machine is invisible.
mustur session send types into one, and refuses a session Mustur did not start.
mustur session stop ends one, and refuses a session Mustur did not start.
No tmux server is reported as no sessions rather than as a failure, and a real tmux failure is still a failure.
Answering a question that names a session types the answer into it, prefixed with the question identifier and the fact that the owner answered.
An answer whose session is gone is still recorded, carrying the reason it was not delivered.

## Risks

Mustur can put words into an agent's input, and at the far end that is indistinguishable from the owner typing. The limits are the mustur/ prefix, the self-describing text, and there being one caller — all enforced in code, none enforced by anything outside this repository.
tmux is the only record of what is running, so a tmux server death loses every session and everything known about them. That is the accepted cost of not mirroring.
A session is started with whatever --cmd is passed; nothing here validates that the command is an agent CLI rather than anything else on the machine.
The clause about surviving a dropped phone connection is only half demonstrable here — a session outlives the process that started it and any client, but nothing connects from a phone until 4b.
